name: print-social-tehhub-posts-grey-orange-arrow-logo-black-and-white
title: 'TehHub' pack in grey and orange with a flag-arrow logo shape and black post-preview cards
whatItIs: Six square posts alternating grey, orange and black: a grey card with a giant orange arrow-flag holding 'Tech', black cards with 'Title of your upcoming post' over a phone photo and a stepped funnel shape, a building photo with an orange rotated square frame, an orange card with the flag shape holding 'Hub', and an office photo with a highlighted headline word.
whatItMeans: Clean and modular; the flag-arrow shape doubles as logo, frame and headline container across a whole post set.
techniques: Reuse one signature shape (a flag-arrow) as logo, frame and container.
Alternate three tones (grey, orange, black) for rhythm.
Rotate a frame shape over a photo for a dynamic crop.

vocabulary.definition: A distinctive form reused across a brand's materials.
A shape narrowing in tiers, suggesting hierarchy or focus.
